Base determination (anchor table, deterministic): task text names no electrode system -> default Chen2020. Discriminant dump of chosen set: Positive/Negative OCP = nmc_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020 / graphite_LGM50_ocp_Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite, matching 'NMC811/graphite baseline teaching parameterization' anchor); Nominal cell capacity 5.0 Ah; this PyBaMM build's Chen2020 carries a complete thermal block (Cell cooling surface area 0.00531 m2, Cell volume 2.42e-5 m3, collector thicknesses present) so no default injection expected on the thermal keys (dump-verified; anchor-table note 'no complete thermal set' not triggered here). Model cold-behavior observation (recorded honestly): electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity functions are temperature-independent in this set (measured sigma(1000,298)/sigma(1000,253)=1.0, D ratio 1.0); no solid-diffusion activation-energy keys; the only Arrhenius cold channel is interfacial kinetics (anode i0 ~4.5x lower at 253.15 K, cathode ~2.1x) - cold-capacity loss in these sims therefore reflects kinetics only.
ceiling_assessment: Opening ceiling assessment (Chen2020 set): levers assessed: separator 12->8 um (-2.0% stack volume), porosities 0.335/0.25->0.28/0.22 (-2.6% volume), electrode thickening t_pos 75.6->~92 / t_neg 85.2->~112 um (energy +~17% before polarization, volume +~15% - mild net W3 gain ~+2-4%), collector thinning 16/12->12/8 um (-2.0%). Pumped combination estimate: W3 ceiling ~870-890 Wh/L (limited by NMC811/graphite capacity and fixed h/geometry) - gap to 880 is small but real; W2 ceiling >> 400 (already passes); W1 (cold retention) near-free in-model (baseline measured 0.994 with cold soak - kinetics-only model); W5 plating FAILS at baseline (anode saturates at end of 4C charge, min anode potential -0.44 V) and needs N/P restructuring (thicker negative) or transport/kinetics improvement - which costs W3. Conclusion: objective may be reachable in-stage but requires coordinated architecture trade-off; material escalation (OKane2022 SiOx system) held as the fallback if the architecture space stalls below 880 Wh/L.
